seo.title: Innovorder & Yavin
seo.description: By integrating Yavin into your Innovorder cash register, you can collect all your orders more quickly and concentrate on your customers.

fields.text-17px: By integrating Yavin into your Innovorder cash register, you can collect all your orders more quickly and concentrate on your customers.
fields.24-rt-gradient-html: Yavin reinvents electronic payment terminals to offer ultra-fast, reliable and innovative POS terminals to foodservice professionals.
fields.rt-features-integration-html:
• Save time by automatically transferring the amount from your till to your POS terminal
  • Automate remote collections from your devices and close your till in 1 click
  • Integrate your payment terminal directly into your order terminals to streamline checkout and order preparation
  • Accept all payment methods on your devices
  • Cash in even without Internet and never lose a sale again
fields.cta-sub-kiosk: By integrating Yavin with Innovorder, create the perfect connection between your cash register software and your payment terminals. Cash in faster, simplify payment and improve transaction management.
